notes: County elections page www.co.midland.tx.us/328/Elections-Office returned HTTP 202 with an empty body to the fetch module, so the county page (and any usage notice or stated change) could not be read; results located directly on Clarity (TX/Midland), whose elections.json lists all three elections. Check 1: 2024 general first night update (8:11 PM CST) was early vote only, election-day precinct votes from 8:36 PM; 2026 primary had election-day precinct votes in all 5 night updates from 7:56 PM CST; 2026 runoff first night update 8:06 PM CDT early only, election-day precinct votes from 8:59 PM. Many versions returned HTTP 404 (13, 13, 28), mostly pre-election test versions; one 2024 night version (351981) and two runoff versions before the 8:06 PM update (372951, 372954) were unreadable. Wayback branch origin/wayback-data was not present when checked (not needed).
tag_rationale: All three elections are LIVE by check 1 (Clarity update log), so the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with confidence high.
